new.heading: New invoice
new.hasDraft_one: This visit has a draft invoice. Continue it instead of making a second bill of the same work.
new.hasDraft_other: This visit has {{count}} draft invoices. Continue one instead of making another bill of the same work.

detail.heading: Invoice
detail.locked: Invoice {{number}} was issued on {{time}} and can no longer be changed.
detail.draftReadOnly: This draft can be changed by someone who may create invoices.

charges.heading: Pending charges
charges.description: Work posted to this visit that is not on a bill yet. Leave off what should not be billed now.
charges.empty: No pending charges on this visit.
charges.tooMany: Only the first {{count}} charges can go on one bill. Issue this one, then bill the rest.

flag.service_archived: Service no longer offered: last price

line.heading: Other lines
line.description_hint: Something not in the price catalog. It is priced here, by hand.
line.tooMany: A bill holds at most {{count}} typed lines.
line.descriptionHint: For example, a copy of the records.
line.unitPriceHint: In the hospital's currency, with a point for the decimals: 12.50
line.priceInvalid: Type an amount with a point for the decimals, such as 12.50.
line.taxClassHint: The hospital’s rate for the class is added when the draft is saved.

list.heading: Invoices
list.description: Every invoice of the hospital, newest first. Find one by its number, the patient's name or MRN.

print.title: Invoice {{number}}
print.notPrintable: Only an issued invoice can be printed.

refused.chargeUnavailable: A charge on this bill was billed or taken by another draft meanwhile. The list has been read again: check it and try again.
refused.notDraft: This invoice was issued meanwhile and can no longer be changed.
refused.conflict: Someone else changed this draft. It has been read again; your choices are kept, so check them and try again.
refused.empty: Put at least one line on the bill.
refused.cancelled: This visit was cancelled and has nothing to bill.
refused.discountApproval: The discount on this bill is above the limit and waits for approval by someone else. It can be issued once it is approved.
refused.discountExceeds: A discount is more than the amount it comes off.
refused.ownDiscount: A discount is approved by someone other than the person who gave it.
refused.discountNotPending: No discount on this bill waits for approval.

payment.heading: Payments
payment.amountHint: Up to {{due}}, what is still due. Less is a part payment.
payment.referenceHint: A card slip, UPI or bank reference. Optional. Never a full card number.

refused.overpayment: That is more than is still due. The balance has been updated.
refused.no_open_register: Cash goes into a cash register session, and you have none open. Open one under Cash register.
refused.invoice_not_payable: This invoice cannot take a payment.

refund.heading: Refund a payment
refund.amountHint: Up to {{held}}, what that payment still holds.
refund.reasonHint: Why the money is returned. Kept with the refund.
refund.amountTooMuch: More than that payment still holds.

refused.refund_exceeds: That is more than the payment still holds. The payments have been read again.
refused.no_open_register: A cash refund comes out of a cash register session, and you have none open. Open one under Cash register.

credit.heading: Credit notes
credit.none: No credit note has been issued.
credit.void: This invoice is void: it was credited in full ({{credited}}).
credit.refundFirst: Money has been paid on this invoice. Refund it before a credit note can be issued.
credit.amountHint: Up to {{left}}, what is not yet paid.
credit.amountHintWhole: Up to {{left}}, what is not yet paid. The whole invoice makes it void.
credit.reasonHint: Why the invoice is credited. Shown on the credit note.

refused.credit_exceeds: That is more than is left of the invoice. It has been read again.
refused.refund_first: Money has been paid on this invoice. Refund it first.
refused.invoice_not_creditable: This invoice cannot take a credit note.

addCharge.heading: Charge a service
addCharge.description: A service of the price catalog, at the price list price in effect. It is posted to this visit as a pending charge.

refused.service_archived: This service is no longer offered. Choose another.
refused.no_price: This service has no price in effect. Set its price in the price catalog first.
refused.service_not_found: This service no longer exists. Choose another.
refused.encounter_cancelled: This visit was cancelled and has nothing to bill.

register.heading: Cash register
register.description: Your cash drawer for this shift: open it with the cash in it, take cash payments, and settle it at the end of the day.
register.noneOpen: You have no cash register open. Cash payments and cash refunds need one.

open.heading: Open the register
open.openingHint: What is in the drawer now, counted. It may be nothing.

working.heading: How the expected cash is worked out
working.cashOnly: Only cash is held in the drawer: other payment modes are not part of the expected cash.

close.heading: Close and settle
close.countedHint: Count the drawer and type the total. The difference is worked out for you.
close.noteHint: Optional. Anything the next person or the accounts should know. Kept with the settlement.

sessions.heading: Cash register sessions
sessions.description: Every shift of the hospital, newest first, with what it took and how the count settled.
sessions.empty: No register session has been opened yet.

detail.heading: Register session
detail.unavailable: This register session is not available.
detail.open: Still open: the figures are as of now.

refused.register_open: You already have a register open. It has been read again.
refused.session_not_found: This register session is not available.

tax.heading: Tax rates
tax.description: The rate of tax for each tax class. A bill takes the rate of a service’s or medicine’s class when its draft is saved; an invoice already issued keeps the rates it was made with.
tax.rateHint: A percentage from 0 to 100, with a point for the decimals: 12.5
tax.rateInvalid: Type a percentage from 0 to 100 with up to two decimals, such as 12.5.
tax.saved: Tax rates saved. Drafts take them when next saved.

discount.heading: Discounts
discount.hint: Take a percentage or an amount off one line or the whole bill, before tax. Every discount has a reason.
discount.removed: Discount removed. Save the draft to keep this.
discount.added: Discount added. Save the draft to keep it.
discount.valueHint: A percentage such as 7.5, or an amount in the hospital’s currency.
discount.percentInvalid: Type a percentage from 0.01 to 100 with up to two decimals, such as 7.5.
discount.amountInvalid: Type an amount above nothing, such as 150 or 150.50.
discount.exceeds: A discount is more than the amount it comes off.
discount.needsApproval: This discount is above the hospital’s limit of {{limit}}% of the bill. Someone other than you must approve it before the invoice is issued.
discount.pending: The discount on this draft waits for approval.
discount.approvedNote: The discount on this draft is approved.
discount.someoneElse: You gave this discount, so someone else must approve it.
discount.waiting: Someone with the right to approve discounts must approve it before it is issued.

limit.heading: Discount limit
limit.description: The most a bill may be discounted without approval, as a share of the bill before tax. A discount above it waits for someone other than the person who gave it.
limit.label: Limit
limit.hint: A percentage from 0 to 100: 5 allows up to 5% off a bill without approval.
limit.saved: Limit saved. It applies when a draft is next saved.

discount.limitInvalid: Type a percentage from 0 to 100 with up to two decimals, such as 5.
